acceptance.multiple_testing: Bonferroni over 2 active families; paired fixed-horizon day/event resampling; require both

base_formula: Phi(log(spot/strike)/(sigma_1m*sqrt(minutes_remaining))); zero log-return drift, no momentum; floor1e-6 ceiling1-1e-6
baseline: same-observation executable YES midpoint for paired forecast; ask baseline additionally reported; executable entries always selected-side ask

candidates.mechanism: Short-horizon venue/reference volatility mismatch may create miscalibration; calibration can remove it without guaranteeing edge. Quotes may update slower than underlying risk in thin periods; compare market on identical rows.
Minute return dispersion can vary across volatility regimes while displayed probabilities adjust imperfectly; fixed two-regime scale correction tests that possibility against paired prices.

cohort: first qualified decision per ticker in [240,300] seconds to close; all exclusions retained

cost_policy.allocation: explicit evidenced allocation, no broker-cash denominator
cost_policy.fee: reviewed effective fee receipt with market class and rounded fresh-price formula; no default zero
cost_policy.slippage: positive reviewed per-contract bound plus adverse decision-to-refresh ask movement

deferred.microstructure: No independently qualified synchronized reference/refresh costs; no experiment selected
deferred.sports: Native transport scope conflict and source-clock qualification remain open; R01-R12 unchanged
